 "data": "classDiagram
 class Capability { <<enumeration>> }
 class Skill { <<enumeration>> }
 class ResourceType { <<enumeration>> }
 class FacilityStatus { <<enumeration>> }
 class RobotCondition { <<enumeration>> }
 class EnvironmentCondition { <<enumeration>> }

 class Location {
 <<interface>>
 +getName() String
 }

 class MartianSurface {
 +INSTANCE : MartianSurface$
 -MartianSurface()
 +getName() String
 +toString() String
 }
 Location <|.. MartianSurface

 class Equipment {
 -name : String
 -functional : boolean
 +Equipment(String name)
 +getName() String
 +isFunctional() boolean
 +damage() void
 +repair() void
 +toString() String
 }

 class Agent {
 <<interface>>
 +String RESPONSIBILITY = \"Anything assigned to missions/emergencies\"
 +getId() String
 +getName() String
 +getLocation() Location
 +setLocation(Location location) void
 +getHomeLocation() Location
 +getCapabilities() Set~Capability~
 +hasCapability(Capability c) boolean
 +getUnusableReason() String
 +isUsable() boolean
 +isAssigned() boolean
 +assignToMission() void
 +release() void
 +isAvailable() boolean
 +getCannotPerformReason(Mission mission) String
 +canPerform(Mission mission) boolean
 +canHandle(EmergencyType type) boolean
 +isRemoteControlled() boolean
 +takeDamage(int amount) void
 +recover(int amount) void
 +tick() void
 +describe() String
 }

 class CrewMember {
 <<abstract>>
 +UNUSABLE_HEALTH_AT_OR_BELOW : int$
 +FATIGUE_LIMIT : int$
 +FATIGUE_PER_TICK : int$
 +REST_PER_TICK : int$
 -id : String
 -name : String
 -home : Location
 -location : Location
 -skills : Set~Skill~
 -health : int
 -fatigue : int
 -assigned : boolean
 #CrewMember(String id, String name, Location home, Set~Skill~ skills)
 +getHealth() int
 +getFatigue() int
 +getSkills() Set~Skill~
 +hasSkill(Skill skill) boolean
 +performDuty()* String
 #lacksCapabilityReason() String
 }
 Agent <|.. CrewMember

 class Scientist {
 +Scientist(String id, String name, Location home, Set~Skill~ skills)
 +performDuty() String
 }
 class Engineer {
 +Engineer(String id, String name, Location home, Set~Skill~ skills)
 +performDuty() String
 +repair(Mission mission) String
 }
 class MedicalOfficer {
 +MedicalOfficer(String id, String name, Location home, Set~Skill~ skills)
 +performDuty() String
 }
 CrewMember <|-- Scientist
 CrewMember <|-- Engineer
 CrewMember <|-- MedicalOfficer

 class Robot {
 <<abstract>>
 +DAMAGE_THRESHOLD : int$
 +IDLE_RECHARGE : int$
 -id : String
 -name : String
 -home : Location
 -location : Location
 -battery : int
 -condition : RobotCondition
 -assigned : boolean
 #Robot(String id, String name, Location home, int battery)
 +getBattery() int
 +drain(int amount) void
 +recharge(int amount) void
 +getCondition() RobotCondition
 +damage() void
 +repair() void
 #getDrainPerTick()* int
 +performFunction()* String
 #lacksCapabilityReason() String
 #batteryReason(Mission m) String
 }
 Agent <|.. Robot

 class ExplorationRover {
 -cargo : List~Equipment~
 +ExplorationRover(String id, String name, Location home, int battery)
 +ExplorationRover(String id, String name, Location home)
 +loadEquipment(Equipment e) void
 +getCargo() List~Equipment~
 +hasEquipment(String equipmentName) boolean
 +performFunction() String
 }
 class RepairRobot {
 +RepairRobot(String id, String name, Location home, int battery)
 +RepairRobot(String id, String name, Location home)
 +performFunction() String
 }
 class Drone {
 +Drone(String id, String name, Location home, int battery)
 +Drone(String id, String name, Location home)
 +performFunction() String
 }
 Robot <|-- ExplorationRover
 Robot <|-- RepairRobot
 Robot <|-- Drone

 class ResourceInventory {
 +get(ResourceType type) int
 +add(ResourceType type, int amount) void
 +remove(ResourceType type, int amount) boolean
 +removeUpTo(ResourceType type, int amount) int
 +total() int
 +snapshot() Map~ResourceType, Integer~
 }

 class Facility {
 <<abstract>>
 +String RESPONSIBILITY = \"Building storing resources and equipment.\"
 -name : String
 -capacity : int
 -status : FacilityStatus
 -inventory : ResourceInventory
 -equipment : List~Equipment~
 #Facility(String name, int capacity)
 +getName() String
 +getCapacity() int
 +getStatus() FacilityStatus
 +setStatus(FacilityStatus status) void
 +isOperational() boolean
 +getStored(ResourceType type) int
 +getAvailable(ResourceType type) int
 +getTotalStored() int
 +store(ResourceType type, int amount) boolean
 +withdraw(ResourceType type, int amount) boolean
 +lose(ResourceType type, int amount) int
 +addEquipment(Equipment e) void
 +getEquipment() List~Equipment~
 +findEquipment(String equipmentName) Equipment
 +getKind()* String
 +describe() String
 +toString() String
 }
 Location <|.. Facility
 Facility *-- ResourceInventory
 Facility o-- \"0..*\" Equipment

 class LifeSupportSystem {
 -functional : boolean
 +isFunctional() boolean
 +setFunctional(boolean functional) void
 +describe() String
 }

 class Habitat {
 -lifeSupport : LifeSupportSystem
 -leaking : boolean
 +Habitat(String name, int capacity)
 +getLifeSupport() LifeSupportSystem
 +isLeaking() boolean
 +setLeaking(boolean leaking) void
 +loseOxygen(int amount) int
 +getKind() String
 }
 Facility <|-- Habitat
 Habitat *-- LifeSupportSystem

 class Laboratory {
 -onFire : boolean
 +Laboratory(String name, int capacity)
 +isOnFire() boolean
 +setOnFire(boolean onFire) void
 +damageAllEquipment() void
 +hasFunctionalEquipment(String equipmentName) boolean
 +getKind() String
 }
 Facility <|-- Laboratory

 class StorageFacility {
 +StorageFacility(String name, int capacity)
 +getKind() String
 }
 Facility <|-- StorageFacility

 class PowerStation {
 -outputUnits : int
 +PowerStation(String name, int capacity, int outputUnits)
 +getOutputUnits() int
 +getKind() String
 }
 Facility <|-- PowerStation

 class CommunicationStation {
 +CommunicationStation(String name, int capacity)
 +isLinkUp() boolean
 +getKind() String
 }
 Facility <|-- CommunicationStation

 class Environment {
 -condition : EnvironmentCondition
 +getCondition() EnvironmentCondition
 +setCondition(EnvironmentCondition condition) void
 +isNormal() boolean
 +isDustStorm() boolean
 +isCommunicationDisrupted() boolean
 +describe() String
 }

 class ColonyReport {
 -ColonyReport()
 +build(MarsColony colony, int currentTime, List~Emergency~ emergencies)$ String
 }

 class Mission { <<interface>> }
